run_link_wiki_wikidata: run the script to link Wikipedia articles with Wikidata entries using an output folder path
link_wikipedia_with_wikidata_by_title: link Wikipedia articles to Wikidata entries by matching article titles first for accuracy
link_wikipedia_with_wikidata_by_id: link Wikipedia articles to Wikidata entries by matching IDs as a fallback when titles fail
build_wikidata_mappings: build title-based and ID-based lookup mappings from parsed Wikidata objects for fast retrieval
dump_merged_wiki_wikidata: dump the merged Wikipedia and Wikidata data to a pickle file in the output folder
